The ritual

Two minutes.
Every morning.

Press three drops into clean skin. The texture absorbs completely — no residue, no shine. You will not notice it is there. Your skin will.

01
Cleanse. Remove overnight from the skin. Pat dry. Do not rub.
02
Press. Three drops into palms. Press — not rub — into face and neck.
03
Continue. SPF over the top. The formula does not conflict with any actives.

The source

Bihar, India.
October harvest.

Our bakuchiol is sourced from a single cooperative farm in Bihar, India — where Psoralea corylifolia grows in the monsoon season and is harvested once annually. Cold-pressed within 48 hours. No solvent extraction. The 5% concentration reflects the highest evidence-backed threshold for visible skin renewal without irritation.
